prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Explore Available Pet Companions", "Browse through species personalities before choosing your perfect desk companion.", "Choose This Species", "3D Interactive Preview"]
1: ["Your Pet is Getting Ready!", "Try interacting with the preview below while we synthesize your pet's desktop behaviors.", "Test Pet Sounds", "Tip: Drag your pet anywhere on screen after adoption."]
2: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Here are 3 quick actions you can use once your pet spawns on your desktop screen.", "Got It, Let's Go!", "Right-click pet to open action menu and stats", "Click and drag to reposition pet on any screen", "Press Alt+P to instantly hide or call your pet back"]
3: ["Craft Your Ideal Pet Personality & Look", "Select a temperament and aesthetic style to build a desktop friend tailored to your workspace.", "Playful Companion", "Calm Focus Buddy"]
4: ["Notice: Use your primary account to make sure your adopted pets remain saved to your device profile.", "Account Sync Enabled"]
5: ["Feel free to minimize this window. We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready on desktop!", "Estimated generation time: ~2 mins", "Notify Me When Ready"]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a official name to seal the adoption papers.", "Sign Papers & Continue", "Enter pet name...", "OFFICIALLY REGISTERED"]
7: ["Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet", "Pick Quick Adoption for instant desktop spawn, or Custom AI for personalized pet traits.", "Quick Adoption (30 seconds)", "Custom AI Creation (Detailed)"]
8: ["Your Pet is Ready to Walk on Your Desktop!", "Checking system settings to make sure your companion renders smoothly over open windows.", "Screen Overlay Permission: Granted", "Graphics Acceleration: Compatible"]
9: ["Bring an AI Desktop Pet to Your Workspace", "Adopt an animated companion that lives on your screen, reacts to your mouse, and keeps you focused.", "Start Adoption Now", "Your desktop workspace is about to get a lot friendlier."]
